title: Ordinary counit comparison for flat second coefficient change
statement: Let $R,A,B,B^{\prime},D$ be commutative rings, with $R$-algebra structures on $A,B,B^{\prime}$, a compatible $B$-algebra structure on $B^{\prime}$, and algebra maps $A\otimes_R B\to D$ and $A\otimes_R B^{\prime}\to D$. Let $B\to B^{\prime}$ be flat, $i\in\mathbf Z$, and $Q$ a cochain complex of $A$-modules. Use the derived categories and scalar-extension conventions of [def-pc-ring-tensor-cohomology] and models $L,K$ of [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model] for $B,B^{\prime}$ respectively. Write $X=(A\otimes_R B)\otimes_A Q$ and $Y=(A\otimes_R B^{\prime})\otimes_A Q$, and $U$ for forgetting scalar actions to additive groups. Let $\phi:UX\to UY$ be an additive chain map that, in every degree, sends $L.\mathrm{ordinaryIso}(b\otimes x)$ to $K.\mathrm{ordinaryIso}(\overline b\otimes x)$ for every $b\in B,x\in Q^j$. Let $c:L.\mathrm{cohomology}(i)\to K.\mathrm{cohomology}(i)$ be the underlying additive map of secondLocalizationCohomologyMap of [lem-pc-second-localization-map]. If $s_X:H^i(UX)\simeq U(H^i X)$ and $s_Y:H^i(UY)\simeq U(H^iY)$ denote canonical forgetful homology isomorphisms, then $U(L.\mathrm{comparison}(i));s_X^{-1};H^i(\phi)=c;U(K.\mathrm{comparison}(i));s_Y^{-1}$. This concerns the ordinary comparisons, before extension to $D$; no $D$-action compatibility or flatness of $D$ is required.

proof.text: Construct the B-linear chain map underlying the given additive phi. Surjectivity of L.ordinaryIso reduces scalar compatibility to pure tensors; hphi and multiplicativity of B to Bp prove it, with zero and addition handled by tensor induction.

Apply the module-linear ordinary counit square to this constructed map. Transport both comparisons along the exact restriction and forgetful homology isomorphisms. Compatibility of these isomorphisms with composition follows by cancelling the homology projection and comparing cycle inclusions. Naturality of mapHomologyIso identifies homology of the forgotten B-linear chain map with homology of phi.

theorem secondLocalization_ordinary_square (hflat : (algebraMap B Bp).Flat) (i : ℤ)
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
    (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A Bp Q D)
    (φ : ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (A ⊗[R] B)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj Q) ⟶
      ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (A ⊗[R] Bp)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] Bp))).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj Q))
    (hφ : ∀ (j : ℤ) (b : B) (x : Q.X j),
      φ.f j (L.ordinaryIso.hom.f j (b ⊗ₜ[R,algebraMap R B] x)) =
        K.ordinaryIso.hom.f j (algebraMap B Bp b ⊗ₜ[R,algebraMap R Bp] x)) :
    (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (A ⊗[R] B)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map (L.comparison i) ≫
      (((((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj Q).sc i).mapHomologyIso
          (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (A ⊗[R] B)) AddCommGrpCat.{u})).inv ≫
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ i =
    (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} B) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
      (secondLocalizationCohomologyMap R A B Bp D hflat Q L K i) ≫
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (A ⊗[R] Bp)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map (K.comparison i) ≫
        (((((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] Bp))).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj Q).sc i).mapHomologyIso
            (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (A ⊗[R] Bp)) AddCommGrpCat.{u})).inv
